name: Hand-Drawn Animation: Character Headshot
description: Image preset for a character headshot in the Hand-Drawn Animation look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for a headshot. Lead with the character's defining facial features, hair, and expression from the entity, then apply the style. Keep the background plain.
context_prompt: head-and-shoulders portrait of the character, face fills the frame, eyes sharp, neutral background that does not compete, classic hand-drawn 2D animation cel, confident tapered ink line, simple rounded shapes built to move, flat colour with one soft shadow pass, gouache painted background, warm storybook palette, soft ambient light
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, anime, gritty texture, extra limbs, blurry, text, watermark
